# Spotify script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## spotify.addToQueue

Adds a song to your Spotify queue. Great for song requests. Fails with an error when no song is found or Spotify says no (for example, nothing is playing).

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `song` | `song` | A song name to search for, like "Never Gonna Give You Up", or a Spotify song link (open.spotify.com/track/...). |

**Gives back:** The song that was added: title, artist, uri (Spotify's id for it) and link.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("spotify.addToQueue", new { song = "Never Gonna Give You Up" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.spotify_add_to_queue(song="Never Gonna Give You Up")
    ```

## spotify.isSignedIn

Checks whether Cuebot is signed in to your Spotify account.

**Gives back:** true when signed in, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("spotify.isSignedIn");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.spotify_is_signed_in()
    ```
